{{Quote|Mandalorians follow the bloodshed, so when the Empire orders an entire planet purged... well, it's been a busy month.|Zenzo|<ref name="TOR:BS" />}}
'''Zenzo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] mercenary during the [[Galactic War]]. While on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he offered a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] to anyone who was willing to fight the [[Morgukai]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].<ref name="TOR:BS" />
